title: Normalize note titles before validation and storage
specification: Fix src/title.mjs so normalizeTitle trims surrounding whitespace from string input and returns an empty string for non-string input. Do not change API or acceptance tests. The UI/API must reject whitespace-only notes and store valid trimmed titles. This is a disposable acceptance pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Whitespace-only titles are rejected and valid titles are trimmed and persist after server restart
